name: tributary_cluster
description: librdkafka options for one Kafka cluster. The scope must start with `kafka://`; `tributary_scan_topic` uses the secret when its topic is written `kafka://<name>/<topic>`. Named parameters passed to the scan override the secret's values. Credential and key options are redacted in `duckdb_secrets()`.

parameters.name: schema.registry.url
parameters.description: Schema Registry URL used to decode JSON-schema topics.
Any other librdkafka global (client) property accepted by `tributary_scan_topic`.

examples.code:
CREATE SECRET prod_kafka (
  TYPE tributary_cluster,
  SCOPE 'kafka://prod',
  "bootstrap.servers" 'broker.example.com:9093',
  "security.protocol" 'SASL_SSL',
  "sasl.mechanism"    'SCRAM-SHA-512',
  "sasl.username"     getenv('KAFKA_USER'),
  "sasl.password"     getenv('KAFKA_PASSWORD')
);

name: tributary_schema_registry
description: Credentials for a Schema Registry. The scope is the registry URL; every `tributary_schema_registry_*` function and a scan with `schema.registry.url` look the secret up by that URL. Basic auth is used when both basic-auth values are set, otherwise the bearer token.
